# REDTEAM #171 (SPEC Sec 19.2, T-301.2): ZGC MUST use a single mapping with
# software unmasking and MUST NOT multi-map pages. This script pins the
# address-field geometry, the off-heap forwarding table, and the evacuation
# threshold in a zgc-linked test binary (page registry initializes from
# zgcInit, which runs only when the linker selects zgc mode). The
# resident-set comparison stays a recorded benchmark metric
# (BenchmarkLogosZgcUnmask), not a pass condition, and the phase gates stay
# closed, so the row stays planned (parent owns the ledger).
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip 'GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving single-mapping gates need amd64 or arm64'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving
go test -v -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=zgc -count=1 -run 'TestLogosZgcLayout|TestLogosZgcLayoutReservedBitsStayZero|TestLogosZgcForwardingTableOffHeap|TestLogosZgcEvacuationThreshold' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcLayout'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcLayoutReservedBitsStayZero'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcForwardingTableOffHeap'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcEvacuationThreshold'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
go test -race -v -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=zgc -count=1 -run 'TestLogosZgcLayout|TestLogosZgcLayoutReservedBitsStayZero|TestLogosZgcForwardingTableOffHeap|TestLogosZgcEvacuationThreshold' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcLayout'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcLayoutReservedBitsStayZero'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcForwardingTableOffHeap'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcEvacuationThreshold'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam171

go 1.27
